subject: accounting
objective: How many units must we sell to break even?
instruction: A producer in Northport sells two lines. The first is priced at 40 USD and costs 24 USD to make, and it makes up 3 units of the mix. The second line is priced at 0 USD, costs 18 USD to make and makes up 2 units of the mix. Fixed costs for the period are 72000 USD. Required: report the weighted contribution margin per unit, the total break-even quantity and the break-even quantity for each line.
